question: India topped the medal tally in 2023 Taoyuan Archery Asia Cup Stage-I World ranking tournament, with ___________ medals.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** has won a total of **10 medals** in the **2023 Taoyuan Archery Asia Cup Stage-I** World ranking tournament.
 
• This is the **highest number of medals **won by any country in the tournament. 
 
• The tournament is a world ranking tournament for archery, held in **Taoyuan, Taiwan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Archery** is a sport where participants** shoot arrows** at a target from a specific distance.
 
• The** Taoyuan Archery Asia Cup** is a series of tournaments held across Asia, where archers from different countries compete for world ranking points. 
 
• India has a strong history in archery, with **Deepika Kumari **being a notable archer who has won multiple medals in international competitions.
